title: A price change the goal research finds blocks a sprint's paid pool record until bench_core.PRICE follows it
goal: When a sprint's goal research records a changed price or billing rate of a pinned model, the plan or start of a sprint with a paid pool record gets a blocking gate, or a task that updates bench_core.PRICE, before the record runs, so pool verify (b) does not fail on the record after its spend
notes: Retrospective SP-ceucrhca 2026-10-12: ST-eorzrshc found Claude Code 2.1.296 prices Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at 0.10 and filed BG-axnjcayu; the orchestrator kept bench_core unchanged for comparability, the smoke (312 runs) passed pool verify, and the record (61.09 USD) failed verify (b) on 8 of 1072 runs, so a fix and a second record (61.29 USD) followed. A smoke is too small to catch a rare off-list run.
